description: This file implements a PermissionRequester class for managing runtime permission requests within an Android application. It handles checking permissions, showing rationales, requesting permissions asynchronously, and guiding users to app settings when necessary.

classes.name: PermissionRequester
classes.description: A class to handle runtime permission requests in Android, including showing rationales and navigating to app settings.

methods.name: requestIfMissing
methods.description: Requests specified permissions if they are missing, showing rationale dialogs if needed, and handling user response asynchronously.

methods.name: showRationaleDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog explaining why permissions are needed, suspending execution until user responds.

methods.name: showSettingsDialog
methods.description: Prompts the user to open the app settings to enable permissions, suspending until dismissed.

methods.name: permissionLabel
methods.description: Provides a user-friendly label for a permission string.
